service.description: getMarketingPublication: the lists the site's Marketing mount offers (or the one named by contactListId), each with its name, description, channel and the consent wording its offer shows; the organization's name. A site without the mount, a list it does not offer (no public offer on this site, the interval not open, archived, a mailbox, another organization's) and a site offering none answer the same NotFound.

requestSubscription: emailAddress, displayName (optional), contactListIds (each offered on this site, at most ten), consent (the box ticked) and operationId (PASS's request key). The address's directory party or a new person is filed pending on each list through the audience's evidenced path (one public request, an expiring confirmation) and a rate-limited verification message is queued on the ledger from a ready transactional sending profile of the organization with the confirmation template the list's policy names, and attempted once the request commits (never inside it). Answers the same receipt whatever happened (a new or a matched party, a member already, a refusal, a repeat of the key, a limit reached). Refuses VALUE_INVALID (the address, the name, no topic, the box) and NotFound (a list not offered).

getSubscriptionRequest: the public request a confirmation link's token names (read only: a mail scanner's fetch changes nothing): the organization, the address masked, the topics with their consent wording, its state (pending, confirmed, closed) and expiry. A wrong, expired or another site's token answers NotFound; each lookup counts against the requester's limit.

verifySubscription (a POST, a bearer write): the request's topics accepted for its address (the person's own confirmation, source the email link), each still offered, under the request's lock; once: a replay answers the first result, and a withdrawal after the request is never undone by it. Answers the request's view and a receipt.

The Marketing app's readiness checks for a site (PublicApps.js): its target an internal organization, a list offered there, a ready transactional sending profile of the organization (a promotional one never sends a verification), a published confirmation template on each offered list, and the site's canonical host.

Internal (P7 review): one attempt of a verification delivery (source MdsrcSubscriptionVerify, any other is left alone), registered by request#Subscription to run on a service worker once the request commits, so the request's answer never waits on the mail; a later attempt is the ledger's run#Deliveries.

Internal, for Shop's checkout opt-in (StoreTopics.js, impl-shop §7, F26): the buyer's store-news choice filed on the store's news list through the audience's evidenced path, source PcsCheckout, pending (the receipt's link confirms it) or, with accept, accepted (a verified account, or the receipt's link); the caller decides who may.
